command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p1-s22-20260912"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye reset >/dev/null || true; SIZE=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell wm size | tail -n1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+x[0-9]+' | tail -n1); W=${SIZE%x*}; H=${SIZE#*x}; X=$((W/2)); Y1=$((H*78/100)); Y2=$((H*32/100)); for i in $(seq 1 8); do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe $X $Y1 $X $Y2 240 >/dev/null; sleep 0.12; done; for i in $(seq 1 8); do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe $X $Y2 $X $Y1 240 >/dev/null; sleep 0.12; done; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye > "$OUT/gfxinfo-radar-p1.txt"; grep -E 'Total frames rendered|Janky frames|50th percentile|90th percentile|95th percentile|99th percentile' "$OUT/gfxinfo-radar-p1.txt" || true; PID=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell logcat -d --pid="$PID" -t 1000 > "$OUT/logcat-tail.txt"; ! grep -Eq 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL|OutOfMemoryError|SQLiteException|SecurityException' "$OUT/logcat-tail.txt"; echo P1_GFXINFO_AND_LOGCHECK_PASS; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
